education_subtitle: Baro, fahmaan oo si firfircoon uga qaybqaataan nolosha Austria
learning_language_subtitle: Jarmal iyo waxbarashada furaha nolol maalmeedka
learning_language_help_desc: Jarmalku wuxuu muhiim u yahay nolol maalmeedka, dugsiga, shaqada iyo xiriirka maamulka.
learning_language_help_daily_desc: Jarmalku waxa uu ku caawiyaa nolol maalmeedka, tusaale ahaan marka aad wax soo iibsanayso ama aad dhakhtarka aadayso.
learning_language_help_school_desc: Jarmalku wuxuu muhiim u yahay dugsiga, tababarka iyo waxbarashada.
learning_language_help_work_desc: Aqoonta wanaagsan ee Jarmalku waxay kaa caawin doontaa noloshaada xirfadeed.
learning_language_help_authorities_desc: Jarmalku wuu caawiyaa marka uu la hadlayo xafiisyada iyo maamulka.
learning_language_courses_desc: Koorsooyinka Jarmalka ee heerarka A1 ilaa A2.
learning_language_adults_desc: Jarmal iyo koorsooyin waxbarasho gaar ahaan dadka waaweyn.
learning_language_everyday_desc: Jarmal ee xaaladaha maalinlaha ah sida booqashooyinka dhakhtarka, ballamaha iyo dukaamaysiga.
learning_language_places_desc: Koorsooyinka Jarmalka ee Upper Austria, Vienna iyo gobolada kale ee federaalka.
learning_language_free: Koorsooyin bilaash ah ama la kabo
learning_language_free_desc: Koorasyo ​​badan waa bilaash ama waa la kabaa.
learning_language_online_desc: Layliyada khadka tooska ah, fiidiyowyada iyo agabka waxbarashada dhijitaalka ah.
education_school_subtitle: Tani waa sida nidaamka waxbarashadu u shaqeeyo
education_children_subtitle: Waxbarashada khasabka ah iyo noocyada dugsiga
education_school_duty_desc: Awstaria, imaanshaha dugsigu waa qasab laga bilaabo da'da 6 jir.
education_primary_desc: Dugsiga hoose wuxuu socdaa 6 ilaa 10 sano.
education_secondary_desc: Dugsiga hoose ka dib, carruurtu waxay dhigtaan dugsiga dhexe ama AHS.
education_after14_desc: Tababar, AHS heerka sare ama dugsiga farsamada gacanta (BHS).
education_registration_desc: Diiwaangelintu waxay ka dhacdaa dugsiga ama beesha ku taal meesha aad degan tahay.
education_documents_desc: Foomka diiwaangelinta, shahaadada dhalashada iyo baasaboorka ama ogolaanshaha joogitaanka.
education_support_desc: Carruurta leh Jarmal yar waxay helaan taageero luqadeed oo dheeraad ah.
education_adults_courses_desc: Koorsooyin loogu talagalay tababar dheeraad ah iyo shahaado.
education_adults_support_desc: Talooyin ku saabsan waddooyinka waxbarashada iyo aqoonsiga shahaadooyinka.
democracy_subtitle: Sida aan u go'aansanno oo aan u wada noolaanno
democracy_definition_desc: Dimuqraadiyadu waxay ka dhigan tahay in dadku ay si wadajir ah u go'aansadaan sida ay u wada nool yihiin.
democracy_rights_desc: Dadka waa loo ogol yahay inay ra'yigooda dhiibtaan, codeeyaan oo ay wax ka sheegaan.
democracy_decisions_desc: Go'aannada muhiimka ah waxay ku yimaadaan doorashooyin, doodo iyo codad.
democracy_daily_desc: Dimuqraadiyadu waxay ka jirtaa qoyska, dugsiga, shaqada iyo wada noolaanshaha.
democracy_participation_desc: Fikir ka dhiibo, dhagaysta oo xal wada raadiya.
democracy_info_desc: Warbixin ku saabsan dimuqraadiyadda oo ku qoran luqad fudud.
education_summary_desc: Waxbarashada, luqadda iyo dimoqraadiyada ayaa kaa caawin doona inaad hesho jidkaaga Austria.
